alignmentMethod: Bounded transcript-conditioned alignment with cached MMS_FA and English wav2vec2 CTC on original mix and Demucs HTDemucs vocals, plus independent stable-whisper large-v3-turbo forced alignment on isolated vocals. Candidate disagreement and selected rationale preserved per word in evidence/alignment-v6.json. Opening hook has unforced recognition and visible voiced-spectrum support; no repeated-hook timing template remains. Full human listening review has not been recorded; sample indices encode selected estimates, not sample-accurate claims.
